content:
anna (Finance): Heads up — invoice from SA-Consulting (Maria) hit AP today but the bank flagged a potential withholding at payment time. Invoice has no TRC or tax breakdown. Do we net the payment or gross-up? Need decision before AP processes.

samir (AP): Can we ask vendor for a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) and a reissued invoice showing tax treatment? If they can provide TRC we usually pay gross. If not, vendor could end up with funds withheld and will chase us.

maria (SA-Consulting): Hey all :wave: we're SA-registered — VAT 123456789. We normally provide a TRC on request. The bank sometimes applies a withholding when beneficiary docs are missing. I can attach TRC and reissue the invoice with a tax line.

li-wei (Legal): Request TRC + any SARS correspondence that confirms residency. If vendor provides, AP can pay gross and we avoid extra steps. If vendor cannot provide, Finance should consider a gross-up clause (Redwood increases the payment so vendor nets the invoiced amount after withholding). Need CFO approval for gross-up policy per SOP.

samir (AP): AP prefers to avoid manual gross-ups. Treasury: can we withhold and remit to SARS on vendor's behalf? We need the withholding code and vendor bank details if so. Also tag invoice for special remittance.

payments-bot: Reminder — SOP: TRC required for foreign withholding relief. If TRC not provided, invoices flagged as 'potential-wht' must be escalated with 'gross-up_approval' tag. See https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/withholding-sop for details.

cfo-jordan: Provisional decision: Approve gross-up only if (a) vendor cannot produce a valid TRC within 5 business days, and (b) expected withholding > 0. Finance to add explicit 'gross-up' line item and route to Legal for contract amendment note. Keep gross-up minimal — only to cover confirmed withholding. :ok_hand:

anna (Finance): Thanks Jordan. Maria, can you send TRC + the reissued invoice (PDF) by EOD Thursday? If we don't have the docs by then we'll apply the gross-up workflow and notify you of timing.

maria (SA-Consulting): Copy that — sending TRC now to anna@redwood.com and will reissue invoice tomorrow morning with the tax line included.

anna (Finance): Great, once we have TRC AP will proceed without gross-up. Will update thread when payment scheduled.

---

Quick invoice checklist (copy for vendor/AP):
```
Required for SA vendor payments:
- Vendor legal name
- VAT reg: 123456789 (if applicable)
- Tax residency certificate attached (TRC.pdf)
- Invoice currency and invoice number
- Gross amount, tax breakdown (if any), withholding line if applicable
- Bank details (IBAN/Swift)
- Contact email for tax docs
```

anna (Finance): tagging this for follow-up in 5 business days. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
